latest.title: Mess Voting System
latest.description: Every college student has complained about the mess food at least once. But what if students could actually vote on what they want to eat, and the canteen admin could see the data in real time? That's exactly what I built. Here's the full story behind the Mess Voting System: why I built it, how it works, the technical decisions I made, and what I learned along the way.

latest.title: Real-Time Wildlife Monitoring and Zone Intelligence using YOLOv8
latest.description: Built a real-time Wildlife Intelligence Command Center with YOLOv8, ResNet50, DeepSORT, OpenCV and Streamlit for live animal detection, species classification, zone monitoring, event logging, analytics visualisation and alert generation. The platform supports webcam and video inputs and is built as a stable, demo-ready AI surveillance system with support for cloud deployment.

latest.title: StyleMe: Personalized Hairstyle Ideas with AI
latest.description: StyleMe is a web app which suggest you different hairstyles based on your face shape . even if you dont know about your face shape this StyleMe will analyze and suggest you in better way. In this article i have described how i build this web app , what are the challenges i faced and what are all the approach i used .

latest.title: Beyond the Queue: Engineering an Agentic, Low-Latency ITSM for the Modern Enterprise
latest.description: Praveen (K.S.R.C.T) made SwiftTriage, an agentic AI ITSM platform. Designed to fix "Triage Fatigue" with Llama 3 on Groq LPUs (latency of less than 800 ms), serverless Neon PostgreSQL, and AWS IAM-modeled RBAC. This in-depth look at the switch from manual routing to automated IT operations.

latest.title: Building an E-commerce Backend with DynamoDB and Aurora PostgreSQL via AWS CLI
latest.description: The AWS Management Console is great for getting started, but clicking through wizards hides how the infrastructure really works. Here is what happened when I forced myself to build, query, and troubleshoot DynamoDB and Aurora PostgreSQL entirely from the command line.

latest.title: A Practical Guide to Integrating Third-Party AI APIs with AWS Services
latest.description: How to build scalable, secure AI-powered applications by combining external AI APIs with AWS managed services, leveraging event-driven design and automation.

latest.title: AI Agent in an Hour: Building Your First Banking Agent with Amazon Q Developer
latest.description: Learn how to build an AI banking agent in under an hour using Amazon Q Developer, the Strands Agents SDK, and Amazon Bedrock — this hands-on AWS workshop walks you through real-world patterns including tool filtering for access control, multi-agent orchestration, and guardrails for safety, all deployed to a managed serverless runtime.

latest.title: Cloud Database Implementation: Navigating NoSQL and Relational Architectures on AWS
latest.description: This project serves as a hands-on exploration of the two primary database paradigms available in the cloud: NoSQL (Non-Relational) and Relational. By using an e-commerce scenario—managing customers, orders, and products—the project demonstrates how to select the right tool for specific data velocity and integrity requirements.
